_provenance.notes: When a fishery experiences a commercial collapse or catastrophic stock decline due to natural or environmental causes, the Governor of Alaska requests a federal fishery disaster declaration under Section 312(a) of the Magnuson-Stevens Act. If approved by the Secretary of Commerce, Congress appropriates relief funds distributed to affected fishermen, processors, municipalities, and scientific research. Alaska has received over $650M in federal disaster assistance across 28 approved declarations since 1989.
